route: Labour permit (State Employment Support Agency; Law on Labour Migration and Government Decree No. 70 of 20 February 2026)

permit.applies: The employer applies electronically through labourmigration.moh.gov.ge (with a qualified electronic signature or stamp)
permit.first: A market test: the vacancy posted on worknet.moh.gov.ge at least 10 working days before applying; a quota from the Agency where the employer takes more than 5 foreigners a year

sources.title: ExpatHub Georgia, Labour Permit in Georgia: A Consolidated Guide; rests on the Law of Georgia on Labour Migration (Matsne) and Government of Georgia Decree No. 70 (20 February 2026)
sources.said: Short-term professional activity lasts no more than 4 months in total within a calendar year. It also cannot exceed your period of legal stay in Georgia. Before you start, your local employer or service organizer must register you in the labour migration electronic system. The registration is free. … If you are an employee, your employer applies for your labour permit. … Standard: decision within 30 calendar days, 200 GEL Expedited: decision within 10 business days, 400 GEL A renewal costs 200 GEL, with a decision within 30 calendar days. … 6 months to 1 year, in all other cases … Up to 1 year each time for the first 5 years

sources.title: MKD Law, Legal Alert: Reform of Labour Migration (March 2026); rests on the Law of Georgia on Labour Migration (Matsne) and Government of Georgia Decree No. 70
sources.said: Prior to employing a foreigner, you must prove no local candidate … Action: Post vacancy on worknet.moh.gov.ge … Duration: At least 10 working days prior to application … labourmigration.moh.gov.ge . … Standard Service 30 Calendar Days GEL 200 … Express Service 10 Working Days GEL 400
